name: EPIC 220281055
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 8.3 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220281055 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.336529 (16th-84th percentiles 7.992135-8.710817), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220281055: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5051.2954 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220281055 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3158.867188 (16th-84th percentiles 3058.046875-3265.351562), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,159 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.91 solar masses and 8.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,051 K at its surface.
